edits.old: Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 and nothing is read or written
edits.new:
Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 and nothing is read or written

  Scenario: AC8 Activity retry and timeout (no legacy criterion covers a retried or timed-out activity)
    Given an activity of the disposal workflow on its fake is retried or does not answer within its timeout
    When the activity is called
    Then no case move is answered until the activity completes
    Then nothing is written to the decision record for the failed attempt

  Scenario: AC9 Disallowed status change is refused (no legacy criterion covers a disallowed transition)
    Given a case in state FLOOR_APPROVED
    When a status change is requested that the state model does not allow
    Then the change is refused and the case stays in its state
    Then nothing is written to the decision record
